items.html: *And the matter: know that in these seven kings there are in them all the aspects of ABYA, and there are in them parts fit to make Atzilut from them, and parts that are not fit to make Atzilut from them but only Beria; and likewise Yetzira and Assiya. And all this is in general; for also in particular, there are parts fit for Arich, some for Aba, some for Ima, some for ZA, and some for the Nukva.
